name: Scotch 'N' Soda Diving
summary: A family-run dive business on the south coast, working from Crystal Waters Beach Bar in Worthing since 1979. They take certified and first-time divers to reefs and wrecks such as Carlisle Bay Marine Park and the SS Stavronikita, and run snorkel trips, lionfish hunting dives and private charters. Payment is in cash on the day.
standouts: Family owned and in operation since 1979
Describes itself as the oldest operating dive business in Barbados
Lionfish hunting dives to help remove an invasive species from the reefs
Private charters for up to 15 guests

contact.address: Crystal Waters Beach Bar, Worthing, Christ Church, Barbados

trips.title: Certified Divers
trips.summary: Boat dives for certified divers at south and west coast sites, from Carlisle Bay Marine Park to the wreck of the SS Stavronikita. Divers need to have dived within the last 12 months. Multi-dive packages bring the price per tank down.
highlights: Open to Open Water, Advanced Open Water or any diver certified by a reputable agency
Dive sites include Carlisle Bay Marine Park, The Muff, Castle Bank, Mount Charlie and the SS Stavronikita
Packages from 1 to 10 tanks, priced in USD
Cash only, paid on the day of the dive

trips.title: Snorkeling Trips
trips.summary: A morning snorkel trip that meets at 9am on the beach, with a wade out to the boat and a 30 minute ride along the south coast to Carlisle Bay Marine Park. Guests snorkel over shipwrecks among turtles and tropical fish. Gear and drinking water are provided.
highlights: 30 minute boat ride down the south coast to Carlisle Bay Marine Park
Snorkelling over shipwrecks, with turtles and tropical fish
Bags kept dry on the wade out to the boat
Cash only, paid on the day of the trip

trips.title: Lionfish Hunting
trips.summary: A dive for certified divers that targets lionfish, an invasive species with no natural predators on Caribbean reefs. Divers get a polespear and a safety briefing on handling the fish, and the crew can clean larger catches for divers to take home.
highlights: Helps remove an invasive species from local reefs
Polespear and all scuba equipment provided
Safety briefing for first-time lionfish hunters
Crew will process larger fish for you to take home
